# Quire — llms.txt
# A quire for every course. Community-built library for Uniuyo engineering.

> Quire is a community library for University of Uyo engineering students:
> past questions, lecture notes, and textbooks organized by course.
> No scattered Drives, no "ask to resend."

## Key pages
- Home: https://usequire.vercel.app/
- Library books: https://usequire.vercel.app/books
- Courses: https://usequire.vercel.app/courses
- Materials archive: https://usequire.vercel.app/materials
- Request a material: https://usequire.vercel.app/requests
- Departments: https://usequire.vercel.app/departments
- About: https://usequire.vercel.app/about

## How it works
1. Pick department, level, and semester to find a course.
2. Open the course to see every material in one place.
3. Preview in the browser, then download.
4. Can't find it? File a request at /requests — contributors fulfill it.

## Sharing
- Book listings accept `?courseCode=XXX&category=all|textBook|pastQuestion|lectureNote&page=1`.
- Course listings accept `?department=<slug>&level=<100-500>&semester=<first|second>`.
